articles.title: Colossal Spinout Astromech Acquires Sister Company Form Bio for $230M
articles.summary: Two Austin startups that spun out of Dallas-based de-extinction behemoth Colossal Biosciences are coming together to tackle challenges in designing genetic medicine. Astromech, an AI company developing models to predict changes in living systems, said today it acquired Form Bio, a business that creates models and tools for designing genetic medicines. …

articles.title: Giga Energy Nails Down $1B Lease With Tech Company for New Data Center in Hunt County
articles.summary: Giga Energy, a developer of modular data centers, has signed a 10-year, $1 billion deal to lease an under-construction data center in Hunt County to an unidentified U.S.-based AI cloud computing services company. Hunt County, part of the Dallas-Fort Worth metro area, is roughly 55 miles northeast of Dallas. …

articles.title: Texas cities and counties forgo $1 billion in taxes to data centers in exchange for few job guarantees
articles.summary: The Tribune found 53 local tax agreements across 34 data centers guaranteed a total of 465 jobs. Roughly half of the agreements had no job stipulations.

articles.title: Texas regulators are resuming environmental permits for data centers
articles.summary: Gov. Greg Abbott, who lost his reelection, had ordered the Texas Commission on Environmental Quality to pause permit approvals related to data centers.

articles.title: “We need to be compensated”: Texas Tech chair pushed Fermi data center company for lucrative deals, despite university ties
articles.summary: Records show Texas Tech Board Chair Cody Campbell pressed Fermi’s former CEO to give him a controlling role and a contract for his oil and gas company worth millions of dollars in stock options. Tech holds Fermi’s land lease.

articles.title: AI and supercomputing merge as universities build GPU clusters at cloud-provider scale
articles.summary: Universities racing to build AI infrastructure are learning that raw compute changes the pace of science itself, from molecular discovery to materials engineering. AI and high-performance computing are converging, and campus technology leaders are now building like cloud operators. The Texas A&M University System is standing up two major clusters for researchers across its 12 […]

articles.title: Data Centers and Gambling Show How Power Works at the Texas Capitol
articles.summary: Heading into the 2027 legislative session, two issues are almost certain to get marquee billing at the Texas Capitol. One is the speculative rush of hyperscaler data center development all across the state. The other is gambling—what activity that covers, whether it should be legalized and to what extent.
